start:
Hi {{name}}, I was built to help simplify the creation of Telegram themes.

Just send me the picture you want to use as the background, and I will suggest some colors for you to choose from. If you don't like the colors I chose, you can also reply to me with a hex code.

If you enjoy the bot, please /donate.
no_theme_found: Either that's not your theme or I can't find a theme for this message 😔
choose_color_1: What color would you like for the backgrounds?
choose_color_2:
What color would you like for the main text?
Current colors: {{colors}}
choose_color_3:
What color would you like for the secondary text?
Current colors: {{colors}}
choose_color_4:
What color would you like as the primary color?
Current colors: {{colors}}
cant_reuse_bg: I cannot allow you to re-use the background color 🚫
type_of_theme: What type of theme do you want?
error: There was an error. Please try with a different picture.
image_too_big: That image is too big. Try sending it as a photo.
invalid_reply: You must reply to a message.
privacy:
Themer Bot stores basic stats such as your user ID, the date you first and last messaged the bot and how many messages you've sent to the bot.

Themer Bot is written and maintained by [Avrumy](tg://user?id=234480941) and a few contributors (/credits) and is [open source](https://github.com/ThemerBot/ThemerBot) under the AGPL Version 3 license.
cannot_fix: I can't seem to figure out how to fix this theme. Please try with a different theme.
anonymous_admins: Sorry, anonymous admins cannot create themes. Please disable anonymous admin or use me in a private chat.
tgx_wallpaper: To add your wallpaper, go to Settings > Themes and Chats > Wallpaper, and choose the wallpaper you want.
